subject: Re: Kickoff: neural view synthesis for immersive previews (Project Meltwater)
body:
Lucia,

Resourcing picture as promised. Compute: overnight scene fits need a steady slice of Cirrus — I'm asking Ines for 128 TPU v5 cores, 6 nights/week through mid-June. Project Meltwater gets first call on my vision-portfolio TPU quota through June; anything left over goes to exploratory work. For interactive rendering tests we'll grab best-effort Titan A100s, no reservation needed.

Staffing: Katya 80% on modeling, Leilani 60% on the capture/ingest pipeline, Emeka 50% on the demo harness. That covers your May 15 pipeline milestone with a little slack.

One flag: multi-host TPU eval is supported in the codebase but our capture rigs output 800x800, and single-V100 rendering sits around 20.77s/frame — fine for offline, not for live manipulation. Let's keep the demo expectations aligned with that.

Ivo
